mintAuthority.summary: DLLR's current Mynt aggregator documents 1:1 bAsset conversions, but the token-owning 48-hour Timelock can replace the authorized MassetManager with any nonzero address, which can mint without a deposit or numeric cap. D14 is unbounded; sampled basket equality does not establish a recurring whole-liability reconciliation regime or verified all-path deposit accounting. GovernorAlpha's nonzero guardian can change the Timelock admin without token voting, so the sole-governor gate fails.

controls.label: Mynt MassetManager (1:1 aggregator mint)
controls.capDescription: Mints DLLR 1:1 only against deposited accepted bAssets (ZUSD, DOC); supply is bounded by deposited underlying stablecoins, not a fresh CDP.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 8935202, owner() on MassetManager proxy 0x5f777270 returned Timelock 0x967c84b731679e36a344002b8e3ce50620a7f69f. EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0x466e023ddd08b53385b4763b883ab63820c123df, whose owner() also returned the same Timelock. The Timelock's delay (storage slot 2) = 0x2a300 = 172800 seconds (48 hours). The Timelock's admin() = GovernorAlpha 0x6496df39d000478a7a7352c01e0e713835051ccd, whose timelock() = Timelock 0x967c84. This confirms a full DAO governance chain: SOV-token GovernorAlpha → 48-hour Timelock → MassetManager.

controls.label: Sovryn GovernorAlpha + 48h Timelock (basket governance)
controls.evidence: GovernorAlpha 0x6496df controls the 48-hour Timelock 0x967c84 that owns the MassetManager and its ProxyAdmin. GovernorAlpha.timelock() returns 0x967c84. SOV stakers vote to authorize changes via GovernorAlpha proposals queued through the Timelock.
controls.capDescription: The Timelock owns DLLR and can call setMassetManagerProxy to authorize any nonzero minter; DLLR.mint checks only that minter, not collateral or a supply cap. Basket admission and upgrades are separate powers.

review.evidence: Historical authority pins retained: at Rootstock block 8935202, MassetManager proxy 0x5f777270 owner() = Timelock 0x967c84b7; EIP-1967 proxy-admin 0x466e023d owner() = the same Timelock. Delay slot0x2a300 is172800 seconds. Timelock admin() = GovernorAlpha0x6496df39 and GovernorAlpha.timelock() returns the Timelock. The August15 review's continuous-basket assertion and October3 continuous-deposit-accounting assertion are withdrawn on2026-10-20 under the shared D33 evidence standard, without renewing the original October3 review start. The cited evidence establishes documented1:1 Mynt conversions and sampled basket/supply equality, not a recurring all-liability-to-backing procedure, explicit cadence or verified complete mint execution by construction. The live manager implementation remains unverified in the access review, so its complete deposit-only reach cannot be inferred from the token's minter check. This withdrawal does not assert a shortfall or measured non-reconciliation. D14/D29 pins remain: at Rootstock block9293830, hash0x8f77258c9cfba3d0da535f26b47e1de9060951f7656ba25946725fdc3b160a41, DLLR.owner() is Timelock0x967c84b731679e36a344002b8e3ce50620a7f69f. Verified setMassetManagerProxy(address) admits any nonzero address; mint(address,uint256) checks only the configured minter, with no deposit or cap check. Historical read-only setter calls from Timelock and raw mint calls from the manager succeeded; simulations are not executed issuance. D29 fails G1: GovernorAlpha.guardian() is0x924f5ad34698fd20c90fe5d5a8a0abd3b42dc711 and verified __queueSetTimelockPendingAdmin/__executeSetTimelockPendingAdmin permit Timelock-admin changes without token voting. delay()=172800 and past-block-checkpoint voting do not remove that root. Complete recursive guardian/admin execution closure is not certified; no governed qualification is asserted. With reconciliation unknown and no qualifying process or prudential supervision established, the annotation is unbounded-adverse. Current primary Mynt conversion documentation was re-read2026-10-20.
